boundary: This contract validates SDLC security metric definitions, reviewer-readiness checklist routing, current risk-register posture, and security-requirements posture.

It exposes current open, blocked, planned, and partially implemented governance work; it does not close hosted GitHub blockers, prove private training completion, prove manual QA, or certify release readiness.
Metric thresholds are governance thresholds for visibility and review cadence, not permission to ignore release blockers.
Use security:release-trust for the fail-closed release-trust mode; it requires zero unresolved high/critical release-blocker risks and zero unimplemented release-blocker requirements.

metrics.title: High-or-critical unresolved risks stay visible
metrics.reviewAction: Review every High or Critical Open/Blocked external risk before release-trust claims.

metrics.title: Risk reviews are not overdue
metrics.reviewAction: Update owner decision, next action, and next-review date before the gate can pass.

metrics.title: Security requirements have no planned P2 backlog
metrics.reviewAction: Implement, re-scope, or explicitly defer any planned security requirement.

metrics.title: Security requirements partial/external blockers stay visible
metrics.reviewAction: Keep hosted GitHub and release-attestation verification blockers visible until owner-authenticated evidence closes them.

metrics.title: Training checklist required topics are present
metrics.reviewAction: Restore required role/topic coverage before relying on the checklist.

metrics.title: Training checklist required sections are present
metrics.reviewAction: Restore required sections before relying on the checklist.

updateTriggers: Risk records are added, mitigated, accepted, blocked, reopened, or reach their next-review date.
Security requirements, release blockers, manual QA requirements, hosted settings, or attestation posture changes.
Reviewer roles, training topics, training cadence, incident-response expectations, or recovery expectations change.
CI, release, dependency, parser, generated-output, source-governance, NLP, or card-certification controls change.
